metadata.short_desc: A media library, search toolkit, and Web console for AstrBot agents.
metadata.desc: A multimedia portal for AI and human collaboration: intelligent media collection, audio/video preview, playback, and visual asset management for AstrBot.

enabled.hint: Start the multimedia management console when the plugin loads.

host.hint: 127.0.0.1 is only accessible locally. 0.0.0.0 allows LAN access.

port.hint: Make sure this does not conflict with the AstrBot dashboard or other services.

access_password.hint: Leave empty to generate a random password at startup.

public_base_url.hint: For example, https://media.example.com or http://192.168.1.2:7003. Leave empty to use the default host:port.

expose_astrbot_data.hint: Allow WebUI to browse files under /astrbot/data. Enable only in trusted environments.

allowed_origins.hint: Leave empty to disable cross-origin access. Add full origins as needed, such as https://panel.example.com.

readonly_token_ttl.hint: Expiration time for read-only media preview tokens used by the WebUI frontend.

share_url_ttl.hint: Expiration time for media access tokens generated by get_media_url or copied share links.

data_token_ttl.hint: Expiration time for /api/data-file access tokens in the Data browser.

totp_enabled.hint: Allow binding a 6-digit one-time code in the Account Security section of the settings panel.

totp_issuer.hint: Service name shown in the Authenticator app.

totp_account.hint: Account identifier shown in the Authenticator app. This is only used for display.

enabled.hint: When disabled, CLIP, face recognition, and other local model features are not loaded, and related APIs and LLM tools are unavailable.

hf_mirror_url.hint: Leave empty to use huggingface.co directly. In restricted networks, use a mirror such as https://hf-mirror.com; model downloads will be rewritten automatically.

max_concurrent_downloads.hint: Downloads are serial by default to avoid bandwidth pressure. Valid range: 1 to 3.

max_file_size_mb.hint: This limit applies to both WebUI uploads and URL downloads. Default: 500MB.

default_move_local.hint: When enabled, save_media(local_path) moves files by default instead of copying them.

allow_local_path_source.description: Allow save_media to accept local file paths
allow_local_path_source.hint: When disabled, the source parameter of save_media only supports URLs, and local files must be uploaded as message attachments. When enabled, the LLM may pass server-local absolute paths through source; combine this with the whitelist below to limit allowed directories.

local_path_whitelist.hint: Only takes effect when allow_local_path_source=true. The source parameter of save_media must be under one of these directories or their subdirectories, otherwise it is rejected. An empty list disables local paths.
